name: ui-indeterminate-bar
title: Indeterminate Bar
description: Một đoạn thanh màu chạy từ trái sang phải trong rãnh, đầu lao trước đuôi đuổi sau nên đoạn thanh giãn ra rồi co lại, lặp liên tục.

moworks.author: moworks

options.lag: of the cycle the tail trails (0.4)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Track 220x8 r4, clipped. Per 1.8 s cycle p: head = power2.inOut(clamp(1.4 p)), tail = power2.inOut(clamp(1.4 p − 0.4)); the accent bar spans tail → head (+6 px), so it stretches while the head leads and shrinks as the tail catches up; both reach the right end and the cycle restarts empty. Recipe: x −30 % → 130 %, 1.8 s ease-in-out. Params: period (1.8 s) · head / tail (lệch 0.4 chu kỳ) · ease (power2.inOut) · track (220x8). head = power2.inOut(clamp(1.4 p)), tail = power2.inOut(clamp(1.4 p − 0.4)); the bar spans tail → head, so it stretches and shrinks.
